next_step: Finalize Dedicated sizing + security questionnaire answers, schedule VPC network design call w/ infra team
notes: Background: WillowBay is a mid-market B2B SaaS focused on knowledge management for sales teams. Evaluating LLM for support assistant + search augmentation.
Initial interest: quick POC via Hosted API to validate prompt set and embeddings; then dedicated capacity for predictable latency and residency controls.
Security posture: SOC2 in their procurement checklist; primary ask is VPC/Dedicated with audit logs, KMS integration and ability to set retention policies per dataset.
From call 2026-02-18: "We need to ensure customer documents never leave our VPC region, and audit trails must be queryable by our compliance team." — Nina O.

POC summary: Hosted API demo 2026-02-24 (Maya, Ethan). Demo covered streaming, tool-calling, embeddings. Team liked latency on small prompt sizes (~120ms median in demo), asked about tail latencies at scale.
Technical constraints: average inference payload ~3k tokens/session, 400 concurrent active users at peak. Target p99 latency < 800ms for chat, throughput ~200 requests/s for embeddings pipeline.
Model preferences: prefer open Llama-family or smaller Open models for cost control; will accept Redwood-verified variants. Interested in quantized model recommendations from Optimize.

Security review kickoff: security questionnaire submitted 2026-03-04. Redwood security contacts: security-sso@redwood.ai. WillowBay requires SOC2 Type II evidence and encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).
Quoted from CTO (follow-up 2026-03-05): 'If you can show deterministic fallbacks and region pinning we'll sign for Dedicated — but SSO and audit logs must be in place.'
POC plan (current): 2-week Hosted API POC (A/B prompt sets + embeddings eval) -> Dedicated sizing workshop -> VPC design -> security signoff -> procurement.
Costs: Procurement is sensitive to per-token and embedding unit economics. Procurement asked for committed-usage pricing examples for 12mo, with burst capacity options.

requirements_summary: Workload: chat-first support assistant + nightly embedding pipeline for search index
Latency targets: p50 ~150-250ms, p95 < 600ms, p99 < 800ms for chat
Throughput targets: 200 requests/s embeddings pipeline (batching ok), 400 concurrent chat sessions at peak
Data controls: VPC deployment, region pinning (us-east-1), audit logs retained 13 months, ability to export logs to their SIEM
Auth/compliance: SSO/SAML, SCIM for user provisioning, SOC2 evidence, customer-managed KMS for key rotation
Fallback/routing: prefer policy that routes to cheaper quantized model during off-peak but auto-fallback to higher-quality variant on errors
Observability: token-level cost dashboards, per-route latency breakdown, and alerting for quality regressions
poc_success_criteria: Hosted API POC demonstrates <10% quality delta vs baseline on 2 eval sets
Embeddings recall >= 0.82 on internal search eval
Median chat latency under 300ms for 90% of test cases in Hosted POC
Dedicated sizing proposal includes VPC design, KMS option and audit log paths
